name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.mem_liftIdeal_iff
summary: Unfold the sum of the principal ideal (r) and the colon ideal; the colon condition on the A_inf-span is the condition on its generators 1 ⊗ c.

steps.claim: Unfold liftIdeal: s = r·t + s' with s' in the colon ideal, and s' multiplies the A_inf-span of the letterProj(1 ⊗ c) into the image of the extension's module iff it does so on the generators, i.e. (s − rt)·constantAt(S, i)(c) = projTriv(S)(x) for some x with the standard exponents of level l.
steps.lean:
simp [liftIdeal,
  ainfLattice, Submodule.map_span, mem_span_singleton_sup, mem_colon, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq',
  mul_comm, constantAt]
